summary: Barrel Energy Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a securities purchase agreement with CFI Capital LLC, issuing a 6% convertible redeemable note with $200,000 principal for $180,000 (OID), netting $173,000 after fees. The note matures August 21, 2027, convertible at 60% of lowest trading price over 20 days (lower in DTC chill/default), with 4.99% beneficial ownership cap and prepayment premiums 105%-140%. This is routine financing, not a special situation.
